ignoreCommand: bash -c 'if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "master" ]; then echo skip:not-master; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- .; then echo skip:no-blog-changes; exit 0; fi; echo build; exit 1'
